sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có cần quay lại không? checks whether a step is required before you spend time on it. It is helpful for forms, tickets, bookings, queues, and documents because the answer can be a simple yes or no.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi có cần quay lại không? once, then make the task visible with your symptom note, medicine box, body area, photo, or translated note. The phrase is doing one job: getting a clear answer about come back.
